rules.SOURCE: Pinned source geometry and license; no independent component positioning
rules.VIEW: One declared front view, or approved parallel stack with hidden rear edges
rules.FRAME: Every sampled curve and its stroke stays within the safe frame
rules.ACCENT: Exactly one meaningful accent, attached to its designated source feature
rules.BUDGET: Accent length is at most 18 percent of the complete base drawing
rules.CONTAINMENT: Internal features stay inside their physical housing
rules.JUNCTION: Connected parts meet at their specified physical boundaries
rules.OCCLUSION: Rear contours and beams never cross the interior of a front housing
rules.STACK: Plural collections have a declared aligned stack
rules.REVIEW: Every icon has a visual review tied to the current geometry and four exports
